items.description: after the down path runs (@pytest.mark.migration, single-step downgrade -1 on the branch DB), stock_records again exposes a combined inventory_code column

seed a fully-split row (uuid-suffixed sku/location with non-null batch_number and serial_number, idempotent seed + cleanup), run the @pytest.mark.migration downgrade, and assert its reconstructed inventory_code equals location, batch, serial rejoined in that order by the hyphen delimiter
after the down path completes (@pytest.mark.migration), the batch_number and serial_number columns are no longer present on stock_records, restoring the pre-split schema shape

seed a row whose batch_number and serial_number are NULL (uuid-suffixed sku/location, idempotent seed + cleanup), run the @pytest.mark.migration downgrade, and assert its inventory_code is reconstructed from the location alone with no trailing hyphen delimiter or literal NULL text

capture the stock_records row count before the @pytest.mark.migration downgrade and assert it is identical afterward (before-vs-after delta of zero, never an absolute whole-table total), proving no row is dropped or duplicated across the rollback
